text:
Ravi (Sales): Quick heads-up — CopperCom reported an overcharge on their pilot invoice. Theywant a one-time rebate + short-term Net60 while pilot finishes.
Elaine (Finance): How big is the request and what's the cause?
Ravi (Sales): Root cause: VAT double-captured due to region-routing tag bug on 2024-03-15. Invoice INV-2024-3321 shows duplicate VAT amounting to $18,500. Ask: refund $18.5k and allow Net60 for pilot invoices only (60 days).
Sam (Acct Mgmt): Commercial summary: 1) one-off credit $18,500, 2) Net60 for pilot only, 3) explicit non-precedent language in amendment.
Elaine (Finance): $18.5k is below the manual CFO threshold. Finance ops can clear with EM sign-off, but we must classify this as a tax/ticketing correction not a pricing concession. Need engineering confirmation and a signed amendment limiting terms.
Ravi (Sales): Engineering traced it to gateway mis-tag TXN-88F2-03; logs attached in ticket. It's a billing system error.
billing-bot: Gateway alert: duplicate tax capture detected. Related: INV-2024-3321, TXN-88F2-03.
Elaine (Finance): Ok. We'll book as "tax adjustment". Provide GL code, approver name for the accounting ticket, and get Legal to add limited-term clause.
Sam (Acct Mgmt): Use GL 6205 - Sales Credits. I'll handle client comms and milestone tracking for conversion.
Nina (Legal): I'll draft a one-paragraph amendment restricting Net60 to pilot duration and stating non-precedent. Send to CopperCom counsel and cc finance.
Elaine (Finance): Approver: Elaine (Finance). Approval contingent on signed amendment + memo clarifying tax correction.
Ravi (Sales): Sending draft logs and routing amendment for signature now.
Sam (Acct Mgmt): For bookkeeping, invoice extract: ```
Invoice: INV-2024-3321
Gross: $24,200 (includes EU VAT)
Duplicate VAT: $18,500
Requested credit: $18,500
```
Nina (Legal): Draft sent to CopperCom legal (ref copper-legal-2024-88). cc sam@redwood, ravi@redwood.
Ravi (Sales): CopperCom legal signed and returned at 16:12. Uploaded signed amendment here: https://drive.redwood/drive/pilot-coppercom/amendment-signed.pdf
Elaine (Finance): Received signed amendment. Approving one-off credit $18,500 vs INV-2024-3321 booked as "tax adjustment". Will apply Net60 for pilot only. Posting approval into TKT-4492 and notifying accounting.
billing-bot: Refund initiated REF-2024-771. Amount: $18,500. Applied to INV-2024-3321. Status: pending settlement.
Ravi (Sales): Awesome - thanks all. Will monitor and follow up on conversion metrics.
Elaine (Finance): Closing note: ledger entry with GL 6205, memo "one-off tax adjustment - CopperCom pilot", flagged non-precedent.
Sam (Acct Mgmt): Noted. I'll add clause reference in renewal to avoid accidental reapplication.
Ravi (Sales): Closing thread. :tada:
